fusions.name: Jaws From the Shallows
fusions.desc: Snaps the tines shut across a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 28 damage to everything in it and leaving each enemy [Pinned] for 2 seconds. A boss or elite takes a further 6% of its maximum health.

fusions.name: Death Roll
fusions.desc: Clamps the tines shut and rolls, dealing 24 damage and leaving the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Held Level
fusions.desc: Veils you for 8 seconds and quickens your movement by 10%. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Still Water
fusions.desc: The moment your stamina is full, your next strike within 5 seconds has 20% more critical hit chance. Once every 15 seconds.
